items.title: Detention Without Physical Examination Of Raw Agricultural Products for Pesticides
items.label: FDA import alert 99-05
items.detail: The U.S. FDA can detain these products from listed firms in Belize at the border (DWPE). Alert last updated 11/25/2026.
